reading: The row a family is unless it states its own value: one value per column, the commonest in the family model. tools/build_family_model.py refuses a default that is not the commonest value of its column, marks on each family the columns in which it departs, and writes the departures alone to manifests/family_departures.tsv. The values are the model's cells as they stand, the census readings among them; a default becomes text only when its cell is sourced from the text.

columns.erasure_route: purge (steward purge on a cosigned notice); legal_hold: none in code
